task: How to check website security (look for HTTPS)
query: How do I check website security by looking for HTTPS?

goal.title: Inspect website security information on a phone and record observations
goal.description: Hold up a note card about website security and HTTPS, then put it beside the phone. Open the browser, type a query and visit a shopping website from the results. Tap the browser address or site-information area to open connection information and a certificate view, scroll through the details and return to the site information. After the final supplied fine boundary, place the phone on the table, write observations about HTTPS and the padlock or connection indication on the note card with a pink marker and hold the completed card up beside the phone.
goal.final_state: The phone shows the website connection information while the completed handwritten security note is held above it. The final writing and display occur after the supplied fine timeline ends.
procedure: Display the security checklist card and pick up the phone.
Search in the browser and open a shopping website.
Inspect the site connection information and certificate details.
Place the phone down and write the observed security indications on the card.
Show the completed note card beside the phone.

phases.description: Hold the handwritten card above the phone and point to its heading about website security and HTTPS.
